_about: All 131 tracks music_find.py found for Wicflow (Mixkit moods/tags energetic, motivating, positive, confident, corporate, upbeat, technology, inspiring, hopeful, corporate-music, cheerful, happy, business, advertising, commercial, success, indie-pop, pop, electronica, future-bass; Incompetech feels bright, uplifting, driving), measured by music_find.py and heard by CLAP (laion/larger_clap_general, 3 x 10 s per track) against music prompts: clap_z are z-scores across these 131 tracks; clap_fit = corporate-upbeat + electronic-pop + premium-tech + 0.5 inspiring - rock - kids - 0.7 folk - 0.7 (vocals - instrumental) - dark - 0.5 (ambient + disco + orchestral). Sorted by clap_fit. The downloads are not kept here (only the two picks, in source/); url re-fetches them. Note music_find's BPM is coarse (lag-quantised): the picks' exact tempos come from music_fit.py.
